mapper.insert: insert into SIMULATION_ITEM( SIMULATION_ID, SIMULATION_ITEM_CATEGORY, SIMULATION_ITEM_NAME, SIMULATION_ITEM_EXPENSE_CATEGORY, SIMULATION_ITEM_APPLY_AMOUNT, APPLY_START_DATE, APPLY_END_DATE, POLICY_ID, RECURRENCE_TYPE, IS_DELETED ) values ( #{simulationId}, #{simulationItemCategory}, #{simulationItemName}, #{simulationItemExpenseCategory}, #{simulationItemApplyAmount}, #{applyStartDate}, #{applyEndDate}, #{policyId}, #{recurrenceType}, false )
mapper.select: select I.SIMULATION_ITEM_ID as simulationItemId, I.SIMULATION_ID as simulationId, I.SIMULATION_ITEM_CATEGORY as simulationItemCategory, I.SIMULATION_ITEM_NAME as simulationItemName, I.SIMULATION_ITEM_EXPENSE_CATEGORY as simulationItemExpenseCategory, I.SIMULATION_ITEM_APPLY_AMOUNT as simulationItemApplyAmount, I.APPLY_START_DATE as applyStartDate, I.APPLY_END_DATE as applyEndDate, I.POLICY_ID as policyId, I.RECURRENCE_TYPE as recurrenceType, I.IS_DELETED as isDeleted from SIMULATION_ITEM I where I.SIMULATION_ID = #{simulationId} and I.IS_DELETED is false

select I.SIMULATION_ITEM_ID as simulationItemId, I.SIMULATION_ID as simulationId, I.SIMULATION_ITEM_CATEGORY as simulationItemCategory, I.SIMULATION_ITEM_NAME as simulationItemName, I.SIMULATION_ITEM_EXPENSE_CATEGORY as simulationItemExpenseCategory, I.SIMULATION_ITEM_APPLY_AMOUNT as simulationItemApplyAmount, I.APPLY_START_DATE as applyStartDate, I.APPLY_END_DATE as applyEndDate, I.RECURRENCE_TYPE as recurrenceType, I.IS_DELETED as isDeleted, I.POLICY_ID as policyId from SIMULATION_ITEM I where I.SIMULATION_ID = #{simulationId} and I.SIMULATION_ITEM_CATEGORY = #{itemCategory} and I.IS_DELETED = false order by I.SIMULATION_ITEM_CATEGORY, I.APPLY_START_DATE
